name: IDBI Bank Ltd.
about: IDBI Bank Limited provides banking and financial solutions to retail and corporate customers in India. It operates through four segments: Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, Treasury Operations, and Other banking operations. The company offers savings, current, and salary accounts, as well as fixed deposits; home, auto, education, mortgage, and personal loans, as well as loans against properties and securities; debit, credit, and prepaid cards; mobile and internet banking; and investment advisory and capital market services. It also provides fund and non-fund-based assistance; packing credit to exporters; receivable buyout with recourse; channel financing for dealers of corporates; scheme for financing automated teller machines/cash dispense vendors; technology upgrading fund scheme for textile and jute industries; and lending to non-banking finance companies/housing finance com

verdict.label: Looks cheap
reasons: Price implies only ~12% a year growth, below the ~22% that history and analysts support, so expectations look modest.
PE of 10 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 15), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 10 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 16 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 26% a year while PE moved 16 → 10.
